STEP 1 - Scene: A snack-style plate of raw/cut produce (apple, cherry tomatoes, carrot sticks, corn pieces), photographed from above at a slight angle.

STEP 2 - Ruler: Oval serving platter, about 30 cm long and 20 cm wide at the widest visible axis. Treat as an oval of roughly 30 x 20 cm: area ≈ 3.14 x 15 x 10 ≈ 470 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: one large apple (red-skinned), about 4 cherry tomatoes, carrot pieces (about 6-7 cut sticks/rounds), and two pieces of sweet corn on the cob (cut rounds).

STEP 4 - Area (percent of platter):
- Apple: ~14% (about 65 cm^2)
- Cherry tomatoes (4): ~6% (about 28 cm^2)
- Carrot pieces: ~9% (about 42 cm^2)
- Corn pieces (2): ~10% (about 47 cm^2)
Total covered ≈ 39% of the platter.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Apple: roughly a 7.5 cm diameter sphere, ~220 ml gross (height ~6 cm envelope over 65 cm^2 ≈ 390 ml, but it is rounded, so ~220 ml).
- Cherry tomatoes: 4 x ~8 ml each ≈ 30 ml... envelope 28 cm^2 x 2 cm ≈ 56 ml.
- Carrots: 42 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 105 ml.
- Corn: 47 cm^2 x 3 cm ≈ 140 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Apple: 220 ml x 0.6 ≈ 130 g (whole apple, ~150 g is typical for a large one; use 170 g as a fuller estimate given the visible size)
- Cherry tomatoes: 56 ml x 0.6 ≈ 35 g
- Carrots: 105 ml x 0.6 ≈ 63 g
- Corn: 140 ml x 0.7 ≈ 98 g

STEP 7 - Energy (kcal/100 g):
- Apple: 170 g x 52 ≈ 88 kcal
- Cherry tomatoes: 35 g x 18 ≈ 6 kcal
- Carrots: 63 g x 41 ≈ 26 kcal
- Corn: 98 g x 86 ≈ 84 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 366 g and ≈ 204 kcal. That is plausible for a modest plate of raw fruit and vegetables with a large apple and two corn pieces.
